item.title: Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB
item.description:
UC Berkeley’s LEANN vector index stores a pruned graph and recomputes embeddings at query time. It matches HNSW accuracy at 90% recall using 4 GB instead of 188 GB, at the cost of seconds-level search.

The post Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
item.description:
Liquid AI released LFM3, 6 open-weight 2B-class models for text, vision, audio, omni and decisions. LFM3-1.7B uses a tri-hybrid backbone, a 256K context window and fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit.

The post Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Mirendil Launches Fern 0.1, Its First Model, With 10M-Token Context
item.description:
Mirendil released Fern 0.1, its first model, pretrained from scratch with a 10M-token context window. It targets agentic AI R&D work, scores 100% on RULER single needle at 10M, but trails frontier models on agentic coding.

The post Mirendil Launches Fern 0.1, Its First Model, With 10M-Token Context appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: vLLM Semantic Router Releases d3-ultra: A 27B Open Multimodal Decision Model
item.description:
vLLM Semantic Router released d3-ultra, a 27B open-weight multimodal decision model. It reads text, images and video once, then returns probabilities for every answer, scoring 87.2 on the team’s SR-Text test.

The post vLLM Semantic Router Releases d3-ultra: A 27B Open Multimodal Decision Model appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Hundred-Page Document Parsing
item.description:
Baidu has released Unlimited OCR 2, an MIT-licensed 3B OCR model that parses hundred-page documents in one request. Its SR-SWA attention keeps per-step decoding cost nearly flat, scoring 77.1 on MarathonDocBench

The post Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Hundred-Page Document Parsing appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Halving GPT-6.1 Sol’s API Price for Agent Work
item.description:
OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast computer-use and vision model priced at $1/$5 per million tokens. It matches GPT-6 Astra’s medium-effort Agents’ Last Exam score at $0.29 per task versus $4.82.

The post OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Halving GPT-6.1 Sol’s API Price for Agent Work appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Nace AI Releases Drex for Search for AI Agents: 92.05% on BrowseComp-Plus With 12.6 Search Calls
item.description:
Nace AI has released Drex for Search, bringing its Drex decision models to document search for AI agents. Nace reports 92.05% on BrowseComp-Plus with 12.6 search calls, and fewer agent turns on OfficeQA Pro.

The post Nace AI Releases Drex for Search for AI Agents: 92.05% on BrowseComp-Plus With 12.6 Search Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
item.description:
Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks.

The post Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model
item.description:
Nanbeige LLM Lab released Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B dense Apache 2.0 model with 512K context. It reports 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and will teach the upcoming Nanbeige4.3-3B.

The post Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
item.description:
Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B. It reads raw DNA in chat, answers in English, and averages 66.7% across 5 DNA benchmarks under Apache 2.0.

The post Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time appeared first on MarkTechPost.
